messages:
maria: Heads-up: scheduling a rolling node drain + reboot for a subset of eu-west3 GPU racks tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. Root cause: thermal gradient on racks 7-10 causing NIC retransmits and degraded KV cache hit rates. We'll do cohorted soft cordons, KV-cache reseed, and prefix-cache preseed.

kevin: How many nodes are we talking? Do we have backfill capacity?

maria: Roughly 6 nodes (48 GPUs total, 8x A100 per rack across those racks). Plan: 6 cohorts, 10min stagger between cohorts, ~15min drain per node, warm-backfill to spin up prefix caches. Expected immediate capacity dip ~2-3%. Tagging tenants as maintenance-euw3-2026-03-21.

olivia: Please add a canary pool for latency-sensitive tenants and ensure router policy prefers dedicated pools where configured. Also set a perf probe after cohort 1.

jamal: Scheduler note: I'll queue the cohorts and add a perf probe job. Probe: run 5x seq-latency checks post-drain; if p99 > 400ms for >5m then abort further cohorts and rollback.

maria: Runbook snippet for operators (shared here so it's in thread):
```
# cordon + drain loop (ops)
for n in rack7 rack8 rack9 rack10; do
  kubectl cordon $n
  ./drain-node.sh $n --grace=60 --dry-run=false
  sleep 600  # stagger 10m between cohorts
done
```
Preseed prefix cache: `kv-cache-preseed --snapshot=/snapshots/euw3-prefix-20260320` before cohort 1.

infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: ID mnt-7171822330, start 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z, cohorts=6, expected impact: short-term throughput dip. Notifying affected tenants via status page and email.

kevin: Cost heads-up: if we spill to burst capacity in other regions we estimate ~12 GPU-hours extra (~$1.2k-$1.6k). Tagging spend to infra/maintenance and alerting finance.

olivia: Add these rollback triggers to the runbook:
- perf probe fail (p99 > 400ms for 5m)
- >1 controller pod crash in a cohort window
- KV cache reseed errors > 3 consecutive failures
If triggered, uncordon node and route traffic to us-west eu-central burst pools.

maria: I'll publish the full runbook and customer comms at 01:30 UTC. On-call rota: @kevin primary, @olivia secondary, jamal will monitor scheduler.

deploy-bot: Canary kernel build `kg-5.17.42-ops` deployed to 172 nodes, health checks green. No immediate red flags.

kevin: Acknowledged. I'll be watching post-cohort metrics and ready to rollback. Ping me in channel and DM if latency climbs.

maria: Thanks. Will post live updates in this thread during the window.
